name: Break-in, theft & attack (leaf axis: device job)
Window & door restraints (hold a door or window shut)
Padlocks, chains & anchors (lock a loose item)
Cameras, doorbells & door entry (watch and answer the door)
Anti-climb & glazing protection (deter climbing and glass break)
Fire, smoke & gas (leaf axis: device job, detect or suppress)
Household injury hazards (leaf axis: site of the hazard and device job; child, baby, older adult and pet are user tags)
Latches & restraints for cabinets, appliances and furniture
Pests (leaf axis: control method; target pest is a tag)
Parts and accessories made for one B8 object (no leaf; ordered by the object served)
Land
axis: Leaf axis: land cover and principal use. Land is filed by its principal land use whether or not it carries buildings or a house; dwellings and farm buildings on it are only an `improvements` facet.

name: Dwellings
axis: Leaf axis: what is owned against the building around it (a whole house; a unit inside a building; a whole building of two or more dwellings; a dwelling kept in place that is not a building).

name: Other buildings & structures
axis: Leaf axis: what the building or structure is for.

name: Houses** (kind axis
axis: attachment to neighbouring dwellings)

name: Flats and maisonettes** (kind axis
axis: levels in the unit)

name: Dwellings kept in place that are not buildings** (kind axis
axis: physical form; listed from least to most fixed)

name: Rooms for people** (garden buildings without their own sink, toilet or entrance; rule 4)
Other buildings by function** (kind axis
axis: the function the building is made for)

name: Drilling, driving & turning (leaf axis: tool family)
Gripping, clamping & work holding (no leaf level; secondary key: work held, hand-held to floor-standing)
Measuring, layout & testing (leaf axis: what is measured or marked)
Lifting, access & materials handling (leaf axis: what is lifted, reached or moved)
Power & air supply (leaf axis: what is supplied)
Tool storage & carrying (no leaf level; secondary key: container form)
axis: Kind key, first yes: drawered cabinet on casters: roller cabinet; box on wheels with a pull handle: wheeled toolbox; rigid case that locks onto other cases of a system: modular stackable tool case; rigid hand-carried box: portable toolbox; soft or hard-bodied bag: tool bag; flexible wrap: tool roll. Membership of a case system (PACKOUT, TSTAK and similar) is a platform attribute, not a kind.

name: Multi-use tools & kits (no leaf level; secondary key: kits first, then equipment serving several tool families)
Parts and accessories made for one tool (leaf axis: the tool family served; nothing that is not a part may sit here)
Cameras (the capture device)
axis: Leaf axis: recording technology (what the image is recorded on).

name: Light
axis: Leaf axis: what the object does with light (makes a flash; gives continuous light; shapes light; holds the source or the studio backdrop).

name: Darkroom and processing
axis: Leaf axis: the stage of the darkroom process the object serves, with materials used across stages in the last leaf.

name: Parts and accessories made for one camera or lens (no leaf)
Dolls, figures & soft toys
axis: Leaf axis: the form of the figure played with or displayed.

name: Figures (scale is a required attribute; prize channel and kit-or-built are attributes)
Scale models & model railways
axis: Leaf axis: the object modelled at scale, by its form (two leaves). Kit or built, subject, material and scale are attributes.

name: Model vehicles & machines (cars, aircraft, ships, armour, mecha)
Model railways (scale and gauge are required attributes)
Games
axis: Leaf axis: the component set owned. Mechanism, theme, audience, player count and playing time are never kinds. Every published title is a named form of its kind.

name: Miniatures games (sold in a game-system box)
Role play & other toys
axis: Leaf axis: the kind of play the toy is made for.

name: Parts and accessories made for one toy or game
Paintings
axis: Leaf axis: none. Kind axis: binder or medium of the paint.

name: Drawings
axis: Leaf axis: none. Kind axis: drawing medium.

name: Prints
axis: Leaf axis: family of printing process, oldest first. Kind axis: the technique. Every print is filed by how it was printed.

name: Relief (ink taken from the raised surface of a block)
Intaglio (ink taken from lines or pits cut or bitten into a metal plate)
Photographs
axis: Leaf axis: process class, ordered by chronology of invention. Kind axis: the process. Every photographic print is filed by process.

name: Sculpture
axis: Leaf axis: material family that makes the form. Kind axis: the material or material-defined type. Figurines are kinds in these leaves; there is no separate figurine sub-family. Form (freestanding, wall-object, bust, relief, outdoor) and size are attributes, not kinds.

name: Wood and other carved organic material
Textile and fibre hangings
axis: Leaf axis: none.

name: Calligraphy
axis: Leaf axis: none.

name: Collage, mosaic and mixed work
axis: Leaf axis: none.

name: Held, carried or used to bless
Parts and accessories made for one religious or funerary object
axis: Leaf axis: the object served.

name: Monitoring and testing devices
axis: Leaf axis: quantity measured or condition tested. Every test and monitor is here, whatever condition it serves.

name: Therapy devices
axis: Leaf axis: therapy delivered.

name: Mobility and transfer aids
axis: Leaf axis: how the body is supported or moved.

name: Daily-living and care aids
axis: Leaf axis: daily task or care need.

name: Sensory and communication aids
axis: Leaf axis: sense or channel compensated.

name: Medicines
axis: Leaf axis: symptom or condition group (the one place in H2 where condition is the leaf axis). All medicines are here, prescription or not. The kind is the labelled use class. A product labelled for two uses is filed by the use printed first on the pack. Active ingredients, strength and dose form are attributes; only brand products are named forms.

name: Supplements
axis: Leaf axis: ingredient class. A single-ingredient product is the kind named by its ingredient; a product that mixes ingredient classes is a multi-ingredient supplement. Format (tablet, capsule, gummy, liquid, powder, spray), strength and ingredient list are attributes. Supplements sold for skin, hair or nails, collagen drinks included, are here.

name: Sports, meal and medical nutrition
axis: Leaf axis: role in training or meals. Sports and meal-replacement products are here in every form (powders, bars, gels, ready-to-drink shakes, tablets).

name: Contraception, barriers and breastfeeding
axis: Leaf axis: purpose, to prevent pregnancy or infection, or to feed. Tests are in H2.1 and medicines in H2.6.

name: First aid and wound care
axis: Leaf axis: form of supply.

name: Supports, braces and prostheses
axis: Leaf axis: what the object does to the body part. Body region is part of the kind name.

name: Parts and accessories made for one device
axis: Leaf axis: device family served. This sub-family is exempt from the sub-family axis above.

name: Walking aids (ordered by support given, least to most)
Vision (ordered worn, then held, then on the eye, then the cane)
Text and document files (read). No leaf. Kind axis: layout form.
Audio files (heard). Leaf axis: kind of recording.
Still-image files (viewed). No leaf. Kind axis: file-format family.
Fonts and production assets (built with). Leaf axis: asset class.
Templates and production packs (kind axis: file kind for the target tool)
Game and platform items (used inside a game or platform account). Leaf axis: role of the item in the game or platform account. Game, platform and rarity are not levels; item designs are named forms.
Names and tokens (registered). Leaf axis: register.
Domain names (kind axis: eligibility class of the TLD)
Rice, grains & flours
axis: Leaf axis, an ordered key, first yes: (1) milled to flour or meal: Flours & meals; (2) a rice grain, whole or flattened: Rice; (3) oats, or a cereal made to eat at breakfast: Oats & breakfast cereals; (4) otherwise: Other grains, pseudo-cereals & starch pearls.

name: Pasta & noodles
axis: Leaf axis is the dough base, an ordered key, first yes: (1) potato dough: Gnocchi; (2) buckwheat in the dough: Buckwheat noodles; (3) egg dough: Egg pasta & egg noodles; (4) rice flour or a pure starch (mung bean, potato): Rice & starch noodles; (5) durum wheat semolina, including whole-wheat durum: Durum wheat pasta; (6) soft wheat flour: Soft-wheat noodles; (7) any other flour: Other-flour pasta & noodles. Fresh or dried is an attribute. Shapes within a family (spaghetti, penne, fusilli) are named forms of the family kind; a maker line is a named form with its cut recorded.

name: Pulses
axis: Leaf axis is the species group. Whole or split (dal) and dried or tinned are attributes: a dried and a tinned pulse of one species are one kind. Pulses cooked plain in water or brine stay here; cooked in a seasoned sauce they are prepared food and not in J5.

name: Nuts & seeds
axis: Leaf axis is the plant group. Form (in shell, shelled, blanched, flaked, ground), roasting and salting are attributes, so ground almonds are almonds. Every nut, chestnut and coconut is here. Nuts coated in chocolate, sugar or batter are not in J5.

name: Oils, fats & vinegars
axis: Leaf axis is the kind of product: plant oil, solid fat, vinegar or cooking liquid.

name: Spices, herbs & salt
axis: Leaf axis is the form of the seasoning: single spice, dried herb, blend, salt. A dried chilli, whole, flaked or ground, sold to season food is a spice.

name: Sugars, honey & syrups
axis: Leaf axis is the sweetener type.

name: Spreads, pastes & dips
axis: Leaf axis is the kind of spread. A spread, paste or dip eaten with other food is here whatever it is made from.

name: Sauces, condiments & stocks
axis: Leaf axis is the product type as standards and shelves class it, an ordered key, first yes: (1) a soy sauce: Soy sauces; (2) another seasoning made by fermenting beans, grain or fish: Other fermented seasonings; (3) a stock or bouillon in any form: Stocks & bouillon; (4) a paste used as a cooking ingredient: Cooking & seasoning pastes; (5) a sauce to cook with or pour over pasta: Cooking & pasta sauces; (6) otherwise: Table sauces, condiments & dressings.

name: Baking ingredients
axis: Leaf axis is the function in the bake or the brew. Holds only products no other family holds; flour, sugar and nuts stay in their own families.

name: Tofu, tempeh & meat alternatives
axis: Leaf axis is how the protein food is made, an ordered key, first yes: (1) texturised or formed to imitate a meat product: Plant-based meat analogues; (2) washed from wheat dough: Seitan & wheat gluten; (3) a whole bean fermented: Tempeh & fermented beans; (4) set as a curd: Tofu & bean-curd products. Firmness and format are attributes.

name: Shoes (closed, non-athletic)
axis: Leaf axis: closure and vamp cut. Dress-shoe kinds are set by lacing and cut.

name: Fastened: laces or a buckle close the shoe over a covered instep.
Slip-on: no fastening; the vamp covers the instep.
Court cut and strap: a low-cut vamp leaves the instep open; the shoe is held by its cut or by a strap.
Boots
axis: Leaf axis: shaft height of the kind's canonical form. A kind keeps its name when one model departs from the canonical height.

name: Calf (to the calf, below the knee)
Slippers (soft, unstructured footwear without a rigid or moulded outsole: the sole is a thin, flexible layer of felt, fabric, leather, suede, foam or thin rubber; no leaf)
Over-footwear (worn over another shoe to cover the foot; no leaf)
Parts and accessories made for one pair of shoes (no leaf)
Jacks, hoists & winches (tools made to service a vehicle, bicycle or machine)
Earth-moving & site machines (self-propelled machine made to dig, lift, load or move material)
Abrasives cut for one power tool
